service.description: The Supplier app's home: a link's one quote or purchase order (token), or the requested and proposed quotes, purchase orders from approval on and bills sent of the suppliers the signed-in contact was invited for; with the buying organization's public contact and the link's expiry. No token and no session is AuthenticationRequired.

A quote order for its QuoteResponse link (token) or a signed-in contact of its supplier (orderId): the published request's revision, response date, specification text and currency, the quote's lines with the supplier's offer, its private draft, and its receipt once submitted. Never another supplier, the internal request, a maximum price or a private file. A revoked, expired or forged token, or a quote no longer requested or proposed, is NotFound.

The supplier's private draft of its quote for the request's current revision (reference, validity, delivery, note, each line's price, promised date and item code); nothing is written to the quote. Throttled per requester.

The supplier's quote for the request's current revision (confirm, operationId), through store#SupplierQuoteItem and store#SupplierQuote on the supplier's claim of that quote: the quote moves to OrderProposed, channel web, the file staged and scanned into OrderContent; a claim for the buyers to review (PurchaseSupplierResponse). Its tiers become prices only when a buyer publishes them. A repeat answers the first receipt; a request changed since it was opened is a Conflict. Throttled per requester.

A purchase order for its link (token, OrderAcknowledgement scope) or a signed-in contact of its supplier (orderId): its revision, buyer, lines with price, required and promised dates, terms, ship-to, a subcontract order's service lines and the components in custody, a drop-ship order's deliveries, and the acknowledgement of the revision. A link of an earlier revision is a Conflict (SupersededRevision).

The supplier's acknowledgement of the order's current revision through record#Acknowledgement on its claim of that order: accepted, accepted with changes or rejected, its reference, note, each line's promised date and quantity (no ordered quantity, price, stock or payment changes), and a scanned file; a claim for the buyers to review. A superseded revision is a Conflict; a repeat answers the first receipt. Throttled per requester.

A drop-ship supplier's report of what it shipped to the buyer's customer (each line's quantity, tracking code, date), kept as the order's content (OctSupplierDeliveryReport) for the buyer to confirm through finalize#DropShipPurchaseOrder; it ships and posts nothing. A repeat answers the first receipt. Throttled per requester.

End the supplier links (QuoteResponse capabilities) of an RFQ's quotes (requestId) or of the given quote orders (orderId, orderIds), for close#QuoteRequest (P12) and any caller closing quotes. Internal: it only ends access, so it checks no permission.

Internal to the SupplierPortalRevoke EECA: an order cancelled or rejected ends its supplier links, and a quote leaving the quote statuses (awarded, declined, not awarded) ends its QuoteResponse links.
